item.title: Overview
item.description: LeMat-Synth is an open-source multi-modal toolbox for extracting structured synthesis procedures and performance data from materials science literature at scale. It was presented at NeurIPS AI4Mat 2025.

item.title: Tutorials
item.description: Seven runnable notebooks that take you from reading LeMat-Synth data to producing it, and finally to changing what gets produced. Each one is self-contained, states its prerequisites and cost up front, and explains what every step is doing rather than just executing it.
